canonical_source.behavior: Reload tenant-owned sites and retained operation history, rebuild recorded connection/synchronization reliability signals, expose loading/error/retry state truthfully, and never claim live health.

laravel_adaptation.loading: Refresh is disabled and aria-busy while the authoritative reliability query is fetching.
laravel_adaptation.success: Success is classified only after query.refetch resolves without an error.
laravel_adaptation.failure: Error-bearing or rejected refetches remain failed and are surfaced through the existing retryable query error state.

acceptance_tests: resources/js/__tests__/site-reliability-reload-control.test.ts — duplicate suppression, success only after clean refetch, truthful error/rejection.
tests/Feature/SiteReliabilityReloadTerminalityTest.php — tenant-only reliability aggregation, connection/sync filtering, read-only behavior, permission denial, foreign-tenant 404, route middleware.

terminality.basis: The canonical ReloadAsync control is bound to a real tenant-scoped retained-history read, blocks duplicate reloads, never fabricates live health, and has focused authorization/isolation/read-only coverage.

scope_exclusions: No ApplyFilters behavior or adjacent reliability controls are claimed
